HediffDef.label: feruchemical tin physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web has been permanently reshaped by tin. Years of storing and tapping senses have left {PAWN_possessive} sight and hearing operating at a heightened baseline even without a tinmind, a gift carved into the very fabric of who {PAWN_pronoun} is.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical pewter physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has been permanently altered by a lifetime of storing and tapping strength. {PAWN_possessive} muscles carry a residual density and {PAWN_possessive} reflexes a sharpness that no ordinary person can match, even when no pewtermind is in use.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical brass physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has permanently adapted to extremes of temperature from years of storing and releasing warmth. {PAWN_possessive} comfortable range has expanded in both directions, a testament to how deeply brass has reshaped {PAWN_possessive} physiology.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical zinc physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s mind has been permanently sharpened by years of storing and tapping mental speed. Even without a zincmind, {PAWN_possessive} thoughts move faster than average, connecting ideas and absorbing knowledge with an efficiency that borders on the uncanny.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical copper physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s relationship with memory has been permanently altered by copper. The act of storing memories so deeply has made {PAWN_possessive} recall exceptional, but the habit of offloading experience into metalminds has left {PAWN_possessive} moment-to-moment awareness slightly dulled.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical bronze physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has been permanently attuned to the rhythms of rest and wakefulness by years of bronze Feruchemy. {PAWN_pronoun} sleeps more efficiently than any ordinary person and {PAWN_possessive} body conserves the energy it has been trained to store.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical steel physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has been permanently reshaped by speed. The muscles and reflexes that powered countless steel taps have left a lasting imprint, and {PAWN_pronoun} moves faster than any ordinary person even without drawing on a steelmind. The cost is a body that struggles to work at a careful, measured pace.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical iron physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has settled into a permanently heavier state from years of iron Feruchemy. {PAWN_possessive} frame carries more mass than it should, making {PAWN_objectPronoun} harder to move and sharpening {PAWN_possessive} combat rhythm through a lifetime of fighting at varying weights.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical gold physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has been permanently invigorated by years of tapping stored health. {PAWN_possessive} immune response and natural healing operate above the human baseline, a residual gift from the vitality {PAWN_pronoun} has poured into and drawn from gold over the years.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical electrum physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s willpower has been permanently fortified by years of storing and tapping determination. {PAWN_possessive} mind resists breaking where others would shatter, and {PAWN_possessive} capacity to endure pain and hardship has been carved into {PAWN_possessive} spirit web by electrum.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical atium physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web bears the marks of a lifetime spent trading years back and forth with atium. Aging has slowed noticeably, but the mental sensitivity from touching temporal Investiture so deeply has left {PAWN_objectPronoun} prone to confusion and mood swings.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical cadmium physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s respiratory system has been permanently altered by cadmium Feruchemy. The breath {PAWN_pronoun} has stored and retrieved over the years has left {PAWN_possessive} lungs operating at a heightened baseline, granting sharpened awareness.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical bendalloy physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s metabolism has been permanently recalibrated by years of storing and tapping energy. {PAWN_possessive} body makes efficient use of the nutrition it receives and can sustain more activity on less fuel, a lasting benefit from a life spent managing energy reserves in bendalloy.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical aluminum physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s sense of self has been permanently fortified by years of storing identity in aluminum. {PAWN_possessive} identity is so rigid and well-defined that Investiture slides off {PAWN_objectPronoun}, but the inflexibility makes it harder to connect with others.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical duralumin physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s capacity for Connection has been permanently expanded by years of duralumin Feruchemy. {PAWN_pronoun} forges bonds and navigates social currents with an ease that comes from having stored and restored Connection more times than most people experience in a lifetime.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical chromium physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s fortune has been permanently shaped by years of storing and tapping luck in chromium. {PAWN_possessive} relationship with chance itself has been altered - subtle but broad improvements in precision and timing touch everything {PAWN_pronoun} does.

HediffDef.label: feruchemical nicrosil physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web has been permanently altered by years of storing Investiture in nicrosil. The pathways through which {PAWN_possessive} power flows have been widened, boosting {PAWN_possessive} investiture capacity but leaving {PAWN_possessive} reserves less efficient.
